IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Education Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives Sullivan, Kenney, Simpson, and Nelson)

Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding community and technical colleges' maintenance and operations funding.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of certificates of participation tofinance maintenance and operations of institutions of higher education;and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state board for community and technical colleges shall receivestate operating funds for maintenance and operations on instructionalspace financed through certificates of participation under chapter39.94 RCW to the same extent state funding would be provided if thespace were financed using state bonds. This section applies to anycurrent or future facility financed by a certificate of participationand for which the legislature has approved the financing contracts forthe facility per RCW 39.94.040.
